name: OncoBreast Calculator
description: Single-timepoint breast cancer patient context, staging, drug lookup, regimen, risk score, pathology extraction beta, support resources, and API guide for clinician-facing agents.

runtime.frontend_agent: calls an agent gateway first, then local rule-based fallback
runtime.local_agent_gateway: localhost automatically calls /api/agent, proxied by web_app.py to Ollama
runtime.external_agent_gateway: optional; configure frontend to call /api/agent or an authenticated hospital backend

starter_prompts: HER2 陽性 LN 轉移病人有哪些藥可以用？
我貼上病理報告後可以抽取哪些欄位？

agent_gateway_contract.tool_id_policy: Return tool_id only when the user explicitly asks to open/call/show a tool. Ordinary clinical questions should be answered directly with an empty tool_id.
agent_gateway_contract.patient_patch_policy: Return patient_patch for free-text extraction. The frontend requires user confirmation before writing fields.

internal_tool_call_policy: The agent gateway should execute internal tools before model response: field extraction, staging calculation, risk score calculation, drug search, and formulation lookup.
guardrails: Do not send PHI to public browser or Netlify endpoints.
Use official guideline and payer sources for final clinical or reimbursement decisions.
Separate anatomic AJCC stage from prognostic stage.
Use human confirmation before applying pathology extraction results.
Use authenticated hospital backend for database lookup, EMR write-back, admin updates, and API secrets.
